name: domain_server
description: Alternative interpretation: on a domain-joined host, the server-side SMB signing parameters decide whether signing is enabled.

assumptions.scope: Domain membership makes the LanmanServer Parameters key authoritative for host SMB signing.
assumptions.sufficiency: Server SMB signing is enabled only when both EnableSecuritySignature and RequireSecuritySignature are 1.

rules.subject: smb_signing
rules.description: A domain-joined host whose server signing flags are both 0 is not an 'SMB signing is enabled' host.
